components.note: 扌 (hand) — hand radical for actions done by hand, as in 找 look for, 拿 take, 抓 grab; 搜 is to search by hand.
叟 (sǒu) — same sound family — 搜 is sōu; 叟 also sounds out 艘 sōu.
生 (birth) — traditional 產 was 生 (birth) topped by 彦 for sound; the idea is giving birth, so bringing forth, as in 生产 and 产生.
角 (horn) — 角 as in 解 untie: 触 first meant to butt with horns, then to touch.
虫 (chóng) — not a reliable sound clue — 触 is chù; the traditional 觸 had 蜀 (shǔ) giving the sound, and 虫 is its remnant.
上 (above) — 上 over 下 squeezed together: something stuck in the middle, the sense of qiǎ (to wedge); kǎ is the borrowed sound for "card" and "car", as in 信用卡 and 卡车.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 抢 is grabbing with the hands; also in 打, 拿, 抓.
仓 (cāng) — near sound — 抢 is qiǎng; 仓 also sounds out 枪 qiāng and 创 chuàng.
力 (strength) — 力 means strength, here force — 劫 is to seize by force; compare 办, 动, 努.
去 (qù) — the sound has drifted — 劫 is jié, so 去 is only a rough clue.
石 (stone) — 石 as in 破 break, 砖 brick: hard things colliding — 碰 is to bump into.
並 (bìng) — loose hint — 碰 is pèng; 並 (bìng) also sounds out 拼 pīn and 屏 píng.
矢 (arrow) — 矩 is a carpenter's square; 矢 here hints at straight measuring — together with 规 compass: 规矩, rules.
巨 (jù) — near sound — 矩 is jǔ; 巨 also sounds out 距 jù and 拒 jù.
火 (fire) — a picture of flames, and a component seen in 烧, 灯, 热 (as the dots 灬), 炒; fire radical for burning and heat.
辶 (movement, road) — 辶 marks going and moving, as in 过, 进, 送; 逃 is to run away.
兆 (zhào) — loose hint — 逃 is táo; 兆 also sounds out 桃 táo (same sound) and 跳 tiào.
足 (foot) — 足 (⻊ on the left) is the foot radical, as in 跳 jump, 路 road, 踢 kick; 跑 is to run.
包 (bāo) — near sound — 跑 is pǎo; 包 also sounds out 抱 bào, 饱 bǎo and 泡 pào.
门 (gate) — a picture of a two-leaf door; as a radical it frames characters of doors and openings — 开, 关, 问, 间.
土 (earth) — earth radical — a base is something solid on the ground, as in 地, 城, 块.
其 (qí) — loose hint — 基 is jī; 其 also sounds out 期 qī and 旗 qí.
禾 (grain) — 禾 is grain — rent was originally paid in grain, as in 种 plant, 秋 autumn.
且 (qiě) — loose hint — 租 is zū; 且 also sounds out 组 zǔ and 祖 zǔ.
木 (wood) — 木 is wood — 析 is to split wood with an axe 斤, then to analyse by breaking things apart, as in 分析.
斤 (jīn) — 斤 is an axe and a weak sound hint — 析 is xī.
匸 (hiding box) — traditional 區 put several 品 (goods) in a box 匸: separate compartments, hence districts; 区 is area, in 地区.
月 (flesh) — ⺼ is the flesh/body radical (月 in 脸, 脚, 肚); 背 is the back of the body.
北 (běi) — near sound — 背 is bèi; 北 originally pictured two people back to back, which is the sense of 背.
反 (opposite) — 反 means opposite or against — 叛 is going against, rebelling.
半 (bàn) — near sound — 叛 is pàn; 半 also sounds out 伴 bàn and 拌 bàn.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 拍 is clapping or patting with the hand, also used for filming and taking photos.
白 (bái) — loose hint — 拍 is pāi; 白 also sounds out 伯 bó and 怕 pà.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 摄 is taking hold, then capturing on camera, as in 拍摄.
寸 (hand, inch) — traditional 導 had 道 (road) plus 寸 (hand): a hand leading along a road; 道 dào is also a near-sound clue for 导 dǎo.
至 (zhì) — same sound — 致 is zhì, like 至 (to arrive); 致 is to cause to arrive, then to bring about.
攵 (tap, strike) — 攵 marks an action performed, as in 教, 放, 收.
月 (flesh) — ⺼ is the body radical (月 in 脑 brain, 脚 foot); 脸 is a body part, the face.
佥 (qiān) — loose hint — 脸 is liǎn; 佥 also sounds out 检 jiǎn, 险 xiǎn and 验 yàn, all ending in -ǎn.
行 (go, road) — 行 (walk, go) splits around the middle — 街 is a road; compare 往 go and 衔.
圭 (guī) — loose hint only — 街 is jiē.
⺮ (bamboo) — 竹 (bamboo) as in 笔, 筷, 篮; boxes and baskets were woven from bamboo, so 箱 is a box or chest.
相 (xiāng) — same sound — 箱 is xiāng, just like 相.
宀 (roof, house) — 宀 is a roof, as in 家 home, 室 room, 安 safe; 宣 was a large hall, where proclamations are made.
巾 (cloth) — 巾 is a cloth radical, as in 帽 hat, 带 belt; 布 is cloth, and by extension to spread or announce, as in 宣布.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 执 is to hold or grasp, then carry out, as in 执行.
纟 (silk, thread) — simplified 糸 (silk); colours came from dyed silk, as in 绿, 紫, 给.
工 (gōng) — near sound — 红 is hóng; 工 also sounds out 江 jiāng and 空 kōng.
马 (horse) — 马 is the horse radical, as in 骑 ride, 驾; 骗 first meant to jump on a horse.
扁 (biǎn) — near sound — 骗 is piàn; 扁 also sounds out 偏 piān, 篇 piān and 遍 biàn.
穴 (cave) — 穴 is a cave or hole, as in 窗 window, 穷 poor; 空 is empty like a hollow.
工 (gōng) — near sound — 空 is kōng; also in 红 hóng.
扌 (hand) — hand radical — 折 shows a hand swinging an axe 斤, so to chop or snap, then to fold and bend.
斤 (axe) — 斤 is an axe, as in 析 and 新; it is the cutting tool.
石 (stone) — 石 is stone, as in 破 break, 砖 brick; 磨 is a millstone and the act of grinding.
麻 (má) — near sound — 磨 is mó; 麻 also sounds out 摩 mó and 魔 mó.
言 (speech) — 言 is the traditional full form of the 讠 radical for speech and language: 说, 话, 语, 请.
心 (heart) — 心 marks thoughts and feelings, as in 想, 思, 感; 念 is to think of someone.
今 (jīn) — loose hint — 念 is niàn; 今 also sounds out 琴 qín and 含 hán, and means "now".
皿 (dish) — 皿 is a dish or container, as in 盘 plate, 盖 cover, 益; 盒 is a box.
合 (hé) — same sound — 盒 is hé, matching 合; 合 also sounds out 哈 hā.
木 (wood) — 木 is wood — cups were first made of wood, as in 桌, 板, 树.
不 (bù) — loose hint — 杯 is bēi; 不 shares just the b- start.
扌 (hand) — hand radical for actions — 掉 is to drop or lose hold.
广 (building) — 广 is a building or wide roof, as in 店 shop, 床 bed, 库 store; 序 is order and sequence.
予 (yǔ) — near sound — 序 is xù; 予 also sounds out 预 yù and 野 yě.
纟 (silk, thread) — simplified 糸 — 绪 first meant the end of a thread, then the clue, as in 头绪, and mood, as in 情绪.
者 (zhě) — loose hint — 绪 is xù.
刂 (knife) — 刂 is 刀 (knife) on the right, as in 到, 别, 利; 创 first meant a cut wound and then to create.
仓 (cāng) — near sound — 创 is chuàng; 仓 also sounds out 抢 qiǎng and 枪 qiāng.
内 (inside) — a person or something entering 入 inside an enclosure 冂: inside, as in 内容.
日 (sun) — 日 is the sun — 暴 originally meant to expose to the sun (still in 暴露), then violent, as in 暴力.
艹 (grass, plants) — 艹 marks plants — 艺 originally meant planting and cultivating, later skill and art.
乙 (yǐ) — near sound — 艺 is yì, same syllable with another tone.
攵 (tap, strike) — 攵 marks an action, here counting; as in 教, 放.
娄 (lóu) — loose hint — 数 is shù; 娄 also sounds out 楼 lóu.
辶 (movement, road) — 辶 marks going and moving — 速 is speed, as in 快速 and 速度.
束 (shù) — near sound — 速 is sù, same syllable with different initial.
广 (building) — 广 is a building radical, as in 店, 床; 度 also sounds out 渡 dù and 镀 dù.
